# Swim Manager

![SwimManager Logo](swimmanager_login_logo.png)

Most UK amateur swimming clubs use [Swim Manager](https://swimmanager.co.uk/), which is a software platform for managing their club.
You will be given an account on Swim Manager when you join the club.
This is our central information repository for everything we do.
You can access your account via the mobile app (available on [Apple](https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/swim-manager/id1475109734) and [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.SwimApp.net.SwimManager) devices) or through a browser.

The main roles Swim Manager plays are:

- storing information about members; name, age, squad, PB times
- training schedules
- managing galas; entries, information, payments, volunteer sign-up
- collecting club fees
- buying Alnwick Dolphins branded kit
- communications with members
- storing club certifications and policies

If you are having any difficulties with your SwimManager account, please contact the [Club Secretary](mailto:secretary@alnwickdolphins.com).
